newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Sulzer unit sees losses doubling.
newsitem.headline: Sulzer unit sees losses doubling.

text.p: Sulzer Rueti division president Helmut Pirchl said he expected the division to have a net operating loss at least double the 34 million Swiss franc deficit reported for 1995.
Asked whether this year's loss would be twice as much as the year before, he answered, "Yes, at least that much."
He declined to be more specific.
Pirchl said his forecast was based on trends in the first nine months, but the exact amount would depend on developments in the final quarter of the year. -- Zurich Editorial +41 1 631 7340
